rows.description: Channels anger into evidence, allies and proper channels, and accepts personal cost when necessary.

A child repeatedly left crying with no comfort learns that need brings nothing, and may go quiet or flat, which looks like being good. Caregivers should respond warmly and consistently; the child is never at fault.

rows.description: A friend says "I will not share with you, you are not my friend". It stings. I can say "that makes me sad" and go play elsewhere. I should not be blamed for wanting a share, and a teacher can help us take turns.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: coercion, envy, fairness, generosity

rows.description: I watched and did nothing, and now I feel bad. I can still fix part of it by checking in with him and telling an adult. Guilt is useful when it moves me to act, not when I bury it.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: coercion, compassion, fear, gratitude, indifference, trust

rows.description: I fight with my younger sibling yet turn fierce when outsiders tease them. Wise: this loyalty is real; show it more kindly at home too. Harmful: bossing them and calling it protection.

rows.description: Heart races and you idealise them from small signs. Wise: let it stay a feeling, get to know the real person over time, and ask directly instead of decoding every text. Immature: building a whole future from one smile.
